name: DSH Forge
subtitle: Build DSH plugins from repos
description: dsh-forge converts agentic repositories into validated, sandbox-tested, deterministically packaged DeepSeek Harness plugins. It discovers workflow candidates, generates complete DSH plugin source via LLM, validates the DSH contract (package.json dsh.bundle.patch, cordis.patch.yml insert block, apply export), runs bwrap sandbox tests with process-group timeout, gates install and activation on both validation and test success, and builds a submission packet for DSH profile maintenance.
capabilities: Agentic repository discovery for DSH plugin candidates
DSH plugin generation from natural language via LLM
bwrap sandbox test with process-group timeout
Gated install into a DSH profile
Submission packet builder for DSH profiles
starterPrompts: Discover which workflows in this repo should become DSH plugin tools.
Generate a complete DSH plugin from this description, validate it, sandbox-test it.
Audit and package this existing DSH plugin for a profile submission.

hostCapabilities.note: Host-native capabilities are used when available; the plugin does not grant these permissions.

note: Repository-maintained evidence format for DSH profile submission. Not a DSH marketplace schema, and not proof of profile approval.
